## Knowledge Base Coverage of Top Support Categories

The Context Engine retrieved pre-built Knowledge Indicators that include summaries of KB articles by category — **no direct query to `precision-kb-articles` was needed**.

**Top ticket categories and KB coverage (from corpus KIs):**

| Category | Ticket Count | KB Coverage Summary |
|---|---|---|
| Integration | 847 | 12 articles covering REST API connectors, webhook setup, OAuth2 flows, and common 4xx error patterns. "Connector Troubleshooting Guide" and "Webhook Delivery Failures" are the most-referenced. |
| Performance | 612 | 4 articles on query optimization and indexing strategy. Gap: no articles on infrastructure-level performance tuning. |
| Billing | 521 | 8 articles on usage-based pricing, invoice FAQs, and overage cap notifications. Well-covered for standard inquiries. |
| API | 389 | 19 articles — the best-documented category. Covers REST endpoints, rate limits, authentication, and SDK guides. |
| Data quality | 298 | 3 articles only — a significant gap given the ticket volume. Existing articles cover ingestion validation but not schema migration or data reconciliation. |

**Key insight:** The data quality gap (298 tickets, only 3 KB articles) represents the highest-ROI documentation opportunity. A single well-written article on schema migration troubleshooting could deflect an estimated 40–60 tickets per quarter.

> **Why this works differently with CE:** The routing KI for `precision-kb-articles` includes pre-generated article summaries by category (corpus KIs). The agent retrieved these KIs directly — no schema discovery, no multi-attempt querying, no field-name trial-and-error.

turns.summary: Getting current ticket category volumes to pair with KB coverage
turns.input: FROM precision-support-tickets | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY category | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10
